updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Safeguard Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from performing external web searches when prompts or search content contain sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations block data leakage risks by stopping sensitive information from being exposed during AI-powered web searches.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Safeguard Prompts for Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot is expanding to government clouds, preventing Copilot from responding to or grounding responses using prompts that contain sensitive data. This ensures government and compliance-focused organizations can safely deploy AI assistants without risking exposure of classified or regulated information.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: The Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards are being consolidated into a single alerts list page, enabling security teams to view both classic and agent-triaged alerts in one location. Enhanced user profile details from Microsoft Entra are now visible directly in alerts, including office location, employee type, and department information.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Layer Integration with Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP is integrating with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect sensitive data and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling enforcement of DLP policies on browser, app, API, and add-in traffic. This helps prevent sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud applications, generative AI platforms, and social media.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Administrators can now define rules that automatically resolve predictable DLP alerts and apply tags for routing without manual intervention. This reduces triage burden by auto-closing low-risk alerts (e.g., trusted partner communications) and labeling alerts for faster categorization and workflow automation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard provides visibility into DLP alert metrics including Mean Time to Alert (MTTA), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), with trend analysis and top exposed Sensitive Information Types. Organizations can define custom SLA thresholds for alert severity levels to measure operational performance against compliance targets.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records for Exchange Online policy violations now include enriched data such as sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information alongside Sensitive Information Type matches. This provides security teams with more context in alerts and Activity Explorer for improved incident investigation and policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending the same classification and governance applied to Microsoft 365 groups and sites. Labels published in the Purview portal automatically apply to cloud security groups with no separate configuration required.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to classify and protect significantly more data at rest. This reduces labeling gaps across existing content and prepares the data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Archive OneDrive and SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now supports archiving actions within retention policies for SharePoint Online and OneDrive, enabling administrators to move inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends retention policy capabilities beyond keep/delete actions to support comprehensive lifecycle governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Hard Delete Capability with Secure Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management is adding hard delete functionality for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, providing an alternative to the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. Compliance admins can now implement more aggressive deletion workflows for sensitive compliance requirements while maintaining safeguards against inadvertent data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now supports access to Archive mailboxes (Main and Auxiliary), providing a unified view of archive content that may physically reside across multiple mailboxes. This prepares organizations for the October 2026 deprecation of EWS Graph APIs by offering modern programmatic access to archive data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Azure PST Import for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables organizations to migrate PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service pattern. The feature includes validation analysis and migration endpoint configuration to streamline PST import operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations should apply security updates promptly, particularly for environments using Key Vault for identity and secrets management.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191: Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online allows unauthorized attackers to perform tampering attacks over the network. Identity and compliance teams should review access controls and audit logs for any suspicious Exchange activity.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56160: Azure Red Hat OpenShift Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations running ARO should prioritize security updates to prevent privilege escalation by authenticated users.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Online Services allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over the network. Security teams should assess whether sensitive data exposure has occurred and review access control policies.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163: Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations using AKS should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthenticated privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization in Azure DNS allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. DNS is often a critical identity and security infrastructure component; organizations should patch promptly to prevent privilege escalation.
